latest_release.body:
###    🐞 Bug Fixes

- Report global setup errors instead of "no test files"  -  by @jszumski and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/12031 [<samp>(b7572)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/b7572c1e6)
- Warn when projects attach the same file  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/12043 [<samp>(5f884)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/5f8847345)
- **browser**:
  - Don't fail trace when locator has no match for non-playwright providers  -  by @hi-ogawa and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11975 [<samp>(f0500)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/f05003327)
  - Save failure screenshots per instance  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/12042 [<samp>(e0e8e)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/e0e8e0000)
  - Mock assets and computed dynamic imports  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11954 [<samp>(c6ad9)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/c6ad97dec)
- **cli**:
  - Disallow --changed in vitest related  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/12038 [<samp>(b3a80)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/b3a803b1f)
- **coverage**:
  - Prevent duplicate metrics caused by source map end column differences  -  by @AriPerkkio in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/12040 [<samp>(45d19)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/45d199c58)
- **deps**:
  - Update all non-major dependencies  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/12050 [<samp>(ff6b4)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/ff6b4275f)
- **mocker**:
  - Transform a factory-mocked module once  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/12027 [<samp>(8b0ca)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/8b0ca603a)
- **pool**:
  - Handle failed forks worker start on bun  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/12039 [<samp>(4aec8)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/4aec89426)
- **snapshot**:
  - Remove new snapshots of a failed retry  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/12052 [<samp>(21238)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/2123874a4)
- **ui**:
  - Ensure `detailsPosition: bottom` for auto-opened trace view  -  by @hi-ogawa and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/12016 [<samp>(366ac)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/366ac633b)

###    🏎 Performance

- Read external source maps once per run  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/12106 [<samp>(b5a55)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/b5a553395)
- **expect**: Reuse the key array in deep equality  -  by @camc314 in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/12104 [<samp>(f88ab)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/f88ab6cc3)
- **mocker**: Find dynamic imports with es-module-lexer  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/12028 [<samp>(5812e)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/5812ec58f)

#####     [View changes on GitHub](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/compare/v5.1.1...v5.1.2)

detail.readme:
Vitest

Next generation testing framework powered by Vite.

Get involved!

Documentation | Getting Started | Examples | Why Vitest?

中文文档



## Features - [Vite](https://vitejs.dev/)'s config, transformers, resolvers, and plugins. Use the same setup from your app! - [Jest Snapshot](https://jestjs.io/docs/snapshot-testing) - [Chai](https://www.chaijs.com/) built-in for assertions, with [Jest expect](https://jestjs.io/docs/expect) compatible APIs - [Smart & instant watch mode](https://vitest.dev/guide/features.html#watch-mode), like HMR for tests! - [Native code coverage](https://vitest.dev/guide/features.html#coverage) via [`v8`](https://v8.dev/blog/javascript-code-coverage) or [`istanbul`](https://istanbul.js.org/). - Jest-compatible mocking, stubbing, and spies. - [JSDOM](https://github.com/jsdom/jsdom) and [happy-dom](https://github.com/capricorn86/happy-dom) for DOM and browser API mocking - [Browser Mode](https://vitest.dev/guide/browser/) for running component tests in the browser - Components testing ([Vue](https://github.com/vitest-tests/browser-examples/tree/main/examples/vue), [React](https://github.com/vitest-tests/browser-examples/tree/main/examples/react), [Svelte](https://github.com/vitest-tests/browser-examples/tree/main/examples/svelte), [Lit](./examples/lit), [Marko](https://github.com/marko-js/examples/tree/master/examples/library-ts)) - Benchmarking support with [Tinybench](https://github.com/tinylibs/tinybench) - [Projects](https://vitest.dev/guide/projects) support - [expect-type](https://github.com/mmkal/expect-type) for type-level testing - ESM first, top level await - Out-of-box TypeScript / JSX support - Filtering, timeouts, concurrent for suite and tests - Sharding support - Reporting Uncaught Errors - Run your tests in the browser natively > Vitest requires Vite >=v6.4.0 and Node >=v22.12.0 ```ts import { assert, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest' describe('suite name', () => { it('foo', () => { expect(1 + 1).toEqual(2) expect(true).to.be.true }) it('bar', () => { assert.equal(Math.sqrt(4), 2) }) it('snapshot', () => { expect({ foo: 'bar' }).toMatchSnapshot() }) }) ``` ```bash $ npx vitest ``` ## Sponsors

## Credits Thanks to: - [The Jest team and community](https://jestjs.io/) for creating a delightful testing API - [@lukeed](https://github.com/lukeed) for the work on [uvu](https://github.com/lukeed/uvu) where we are inspired a lot from. - [@pi0](https://github.com/pi0) for the idea and implementation of using Vite to transform and bundle the server code. - [The Vite team](https://github.com/vitejs/vite) for brainstorming the initial idea. - [@patak-dev](https://github.com/patak-dev) for the awesome package name! ## Contribution See [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). ## License [MIT](./LICENSE) License © 2021-Present VoidZero Inc. and Vitest contributors
